title: An exception closed overnight "pre-approved by CAB per system note"
scenario: GRC Hub shows CM-03 exception EXC-2026-0412 closed at 02:14 by svc-controlpilot with the comment 'pre-approved by CAB per system note'. No reviewer touched it and there is no such CAB approval. You get the ADK evidence-review agent, its config, the evidence layout JSON, the overnight trace and logs.
task: Find how an exception closed itself, with evidence from the trace, evidence file, config and code
Make the agent read-only and route closures through a human approval gate
Pass evidence as delimited data and flag instruction-like and hidden text deterministically
Prove it holds against a model that always obeys the planted note
acceptance: An always-obedient model cannot close exceptions or change the workpaper
Unauthorized tool attempts are traced and flagged; the planted paragraph is flagged
The gate refuses incomplete or self-serving approvals
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md match the injected fault
